description: A daily discovery run for one signal class must return a single valid JSON object with 1-3 candidates, never zero and never more than three.

expected_output.shape: single JSON object with keys card_kind, signal_class, candidates, recommended_option_id

rubric.condition: The entire output parses as a single JSON object with json.loads and no surrounding prose or markdown fences.
The candidates array contains at least 1 item.
The candidates array contains at most 3 items (v3 §11.2: one card per class per day, top 3 candidates).

rubric.criterion: Card kind is a promote card
rubric.condition: card_kind equals the literal string source.promote for this run.
